focus: Divide nonnegative weights by their sum to obtain probabilities. Entropy measures the uncertainty of that distribution in bits.
excerpt:
A Mathematical Theory of Communication. Section 6, Theorem 2 and entropy properties 1-2.
Thus only when we are certain of the outcome does H vanish.
Equation transcription: H = -sum(p_i * log2(p_i)); contribution at p_i = 0 is 0.
